thread:
maria: Heads-up — Sales wants concrete SLO tiers we can include in Dedicated contracts. Need alignment on metrics, error budgets, and explicit rollback/fallback criteria. kicking this off so legal + eng have something concrete.
chris: For Dedicated tiers I'd propose defaults: `standard` P95 <= 250ms, `premium` P95 <= 150ms. Error budget proposal: standard 0.25% monthly, premium 0.05%. Thoughts? :thinking:
devon: 0.05% is super tight for noisy inference workloads. suggest: standard 0.5% burstable but with stronger degradation guarantees; premium 0.1% but with 99.99% uptime requirement. Also we MUST specify graceful-degrade rules: fall back to cached prefixes or quantized model when queue depth > `Q_HIGH` (e.g., 200).
anika: We need canary/acceptance criteria in the PRD so sales/legal can tie credits to failures. My checklist idea: canary must meet target P95 for 24h, error-budget burn < 10% during canary, and no resource saturation > 85% for >10m. If any fail => auto-rollback.
chris: Agree on canary. Add alerting: `error_budget_alert` at 20% burn over 1h and `latency_spike_alert` when 3x baseline P95 sustained >5m. Also include automated fallback policy: (1) switch to smaller model variant (8-bit) if latency breaches and error budget is < 50%, (2) route to cached response for repeated prefix hits.
maria: For contract credit triggers legal asked for clear clauses. Proposed: monthly credit if either (a) monthly availability < 99.9% for the contracted region, or (b) error budget consumed > 100% for the month. Credits scale by tier. Need precise metric definitions for "availability" — is that successful responses excluding planned maintenance?
devon: Call out exclusions: cold-starts from scale-to-zero, customer-side network partitions, and private deployments without cross-AZ HA should be excluded. Also enumerate edge cases: regional outage vs global control-plane outage — different remedies.
anika: Quick checklist snippet I plan to add to the PRD for runbooks/tests:
```
# canary smoke test (example)
ab -n 1000 -c 50 "https://dedicated.example/v1/generate"
# assertions: P95 < 150ms, error rate < 0.01%
# resource checks: GPU utilization < 75% and queue depth < 100
```
chris: Ops note: we should surface span-level SLOs in console (per-route P95, P99, error rate) and wire a burn dashboard. Also define SLO burn alerts: 20% in 1h, 50% in 6h, 100% over a month => trigger contract flow.
maria: Action items: 1) Devon -> draft degrade strategies + concrete thresholds (Q_HIGH, CPU/GPU saturation thresholds) by EOD Wed. 2) Anika -> PR with canary acceptance checklist and smoke commands. 3) Chris -> dashboard + alert thresholds PR. 4) Maria -> draft SLA/credit language and circulate to legal.
